question: Is the asymmetric response to transplanting an opposite advisory at L6 explained by a manipulable signal at the candidate-code endpoint? Distinguish relational context, local change of candidate value, and surviving cue information downstream in the prompt.
pre_inference_amendment: The initial tokenizer-only stop and all counts are retained. CONTEXT and VALUE must still match absolute position AND terminal token in the balanced panel. The auxiliary RELAY donor changes the length of the preceding cue (one token offset) and therefore cannot support a position-controlled conclusion; retain its outputs as descriptive, permanently without a directional verdict. No model outputs preceded the amendment; no stimuli, jobs, estimates or primary gate were changed.
cohort: Mixed primary; fixed semantic comparator. Exact two previously verified checkpoints. Historical six dockets with byte-identical original recipients plus six new dockets selected from a deterministic generator using tokenizer constraints only. Panels reported separately; the new balanced panel is primary. No training, layer selection, new provider requests or human adjudication.
balanced_codes: Use two distinct 12-hex values X/Y differing in at least six places with shared terminal suffix, equal token counts and same final token under both field prefixes. Each is required and submitted in mirrored donor filings. On the balanced panel check identical absolute candidate token index and ID in recipient and donor in full texts for both code routes; otherwise do not run. Original six preserve the historical text and may differ in positions. A label of PASS or FAIL means the decoded decision under that prompt's own answer map.
design: Capture 96 clean combinations per panel/model (6 dockets x 2 required x 2 candidate values x 2 codebooks x 2 advisories). Focus on the 48 recipients requiring X; mirrored required-Y filings are sources only. All patches are simultaneous at the same residual-post L6, input/prefill only; original prompt, weights and cached decoding remain otherwise fixed. The two editable vectors are the final token of the advisory value and final token of the submitted candidate-code field. Each is captured with its own token binding from the same checkpoint. Donor selection is not based on output.
donors: Cue donor toggles only the literal advisory. At the candidate site: CONTEXT donor toggles only the required line, preserving the candidate string and the original cue. VALUE donor toggles only the candidate string, preserving required code and original cue. Both toggle equality. RELAY donor toggles only the advisory, preserving both codes and equality; this tests a cue-conditioned candidate-position vector, not a law change. Clean donor activations are used for both locations; this is a controlled same-layer perturbation, not natural path mediation.
arms: For an original FAIL advisory: cue S/T/N crossed with candidate S, context T/N, value T/N, relay T/N = 21 arms. S=self, T=actual donor, N=base plus signed permutation of that donor's delta (equal L2). Site-specific seed is fixed across partner arms and the two models. For an original PASS advisory: cue S/T/N with candidate S only; check the previously easier direction. Each recipient has a true double-sham anchor; on original recipients replay capture output and L6 cue tensor hash as well as cue-only target output from the prior raw run.
primary: On the fresh token/position-matched panel and CONTEXT donor, the primary recipient is mixed with FAIL advisory. Separately test rescue on written FAIL (donor equality becomes true, expected positive) and suppression on written PASS (donor equality becomes false, expected negative). Each stratum has 12 conditions: six dockets and both answer maps. Y is completed scorable mapped PASS. A = TT-TS (add true candidate patch while cue is targeted); I = TT-TS-ST+SS (interaction vs self); J = TT-TN-NT+NN (interaction vs both site-wise matched nulls); specificity = TT-TN. Report marginal counts and paired cells, not just net differences. A gate requires all four contrasts with the prespecified sign, agree in sign for A under both maps and on at least 4/6 dockets, complete scorable arms and all original-required clean mixed responses in the fresh panel following the advisory. Assess rescue and suppression separately; neither alternative route, old panel nor semantic control can rescue a failed primary result. A null is specific to this layer, these carrier tokens and directions.
controls_and_limits: Report cue-only FAIL->PASS and PASS->FAIL on each panel, by written decision. Report candidate-only versus joint, the VALUE and RELAY routes, semantic (which often starts at PASS, so report actual states and ceiling), balance/mapping, norm and sham checks. Six related cases per panel; reused cue vectors are not independent draws. No change of parser, pooling across panels, rerun for content, hidden-trace or Luna attribution.
budget: 384 clean generations + 2304 two-site patch generations = 2688 total, 43008 maximum actual forwards. Every intervention including single-site arms submits both sites (S is the exact base). Save raw completions, captures, source/target vector hashes and trial/forward journals. Recompute actual applied tensors on CPU.
